privacy.note: No partner names, birth data, locations, or direct identifiers are stored.

new_measurement_requirements: Sexual attraction/desire must be directional: A_desire_for_B and B_desire_for_A.

Dyadic sexual chemistry/satisfaction must not be inferred from either actor's attraction alone; preserve baseline libido, desire discrepancy, responsiveness, and actual sexual satisfaction separately.
Intellectual stimulation must remain separate from intellectual compatibility, partner intellectual functioning, communication quality, and communication volume.
Communication quality must remain separate from amount of conversation; a relationship can communicate well when there is little shared content to discuss.
Shared interests/commonality and mystical/spiritual stimulation require independent axes rather than being folded into intellectual compatibility.
Love/bond and willingness to commit can remain high despite weak sex, low commonality, or low stimulation.
Observed low drama must remain separate from inferred internal emotional ease when a partner is opaque or difficult to read.

partner_functioning_note.epistemic_rule: Do not convert the user's causal interpretation of impairment into a clinical or metaphysical diagnosis. Preserve only the observed distinction between capability and functioning.

user_to_partner.evidence: partner appeared to grasp difficult Buddhist concepts quickly and apply them quickly with good results

pair_4.entry_context: Partner interest was communicated indirectly before the user initiated contact; relationship began despite little substantive commonality.

new_discriminating_contrasts: Pair 2: extreme partner sexual desire toward user does not imply equally extreme user desire toward partner.
Pair 4: user physical attraction does not imply good sexual chemistry when partner libido is low.
Pair 4: very high mutual love and marriage willingness can coexist with poor sex, low commonality, and low stimulation.
Pair 4: good communication quality can coexist with little conversation because there is little shared content.
Pair 2: emotional ease can be excellent at distance/low threat and poor under high romantic-priority threat; do not assign one fixed ease/engulfment value.
Pair 3: low visible drama is weak evidence for internal emotional ease when observability is poor.
